annotations.text:
Start here — this artboard is live.

Scroll to "Keep it on this device" and press Install to watch the offer become a report. The Install state chip above the frame is the browser talking: prompt is Chromium having said the app is installable, manual is iOS (no API exists — the reader's own three taps), dismissed is after a refusal, installed is after the fact, and unavailable removes the whole section, heading included.

Setup runs once; this is where the offer lives for good.

Same component, same states, same rule — present when there is an install to make or one to report, absent when there is neither. Someone who ignored the section, or opened the deploy on a second device, finds it here rather than hunting the address bar.

The one decision worth arguing: where the install offer goes.

A is built. B is drawn because it is the cheapest thing that could work. C was built first, against the two-step ceremony that existed then — ADR 0078 has since cut setup to one screen and one question, so a stepper would now undo that rather than place anything. Each states its own cost.
